ops.text: (x) Array Transition Assistance; Return of Ono Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (A) at Ono's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of up to six (6) months at Array's then-current rates; (B) return to Ono all Data and other Confidential Information of Ono in Array's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination; and (C) thereafter delete such Data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Ono in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV's exit mechanics run only in Array's favour, so we add a reciprocal sub-paragraph: up to six (6) months' transition assistance at Array's then-current rates, return of our Data and Confidential Information in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. If Array prefers, we can fall back to 90 days' assistance with the same 30-day data export.
input.summary: Insert reciprocal Array transition-assistance and Ono data return/deletion as new Section 14.2(a)(x)
